Kaliningrad Oblast Governor Alexey Besprozvannykh's visited the 689th Guards Fighter Aviation Regiment of the Russian Aerospace Forces (VKS), based at Chkalovsk Air Base in Kaliningrad Oblast, the regiment was re-equipped last year with new Su-35S and Su-30SM2 fighter aircraft.
In 2024, the 689th Aviation Regiment was transferred from the Baltic Fleet's Naval Aviation, where it had served since 1994, to the 6th Leningrad Red Banner Air and Air Defense Army. It is now reported to be part of the newly formed 149th Mixed Aviation Division of that army.
The regiment had already received four two-seat Su-30SM2 fighters in late 2023. However, until recently, its primary aircraft remained the aging Su-27 fighters. A number of Su-27P and Su-27UB aircraft remain in service with the regiment.
Personnel from the regiment are participating in Russia's “Special Military Operation.”
